_comment: Rules for the workspace pre-publish audit, run against whatever ref is about to be pushed:
`deny` holds strings the built-in patterns cannot know about, because they look like ordinary
words to a generic scanner. Each pattern is written with a character class around one letter so
that this file does not itself contain the literal string it is looking for.
`allow` holds the expected placeholders, each with a reason. Loosening a pattern to silence a
finding is how the next real one gets through.
The audit reads the CURRENT TREE ONLY. A push publishes every reachable commit, so scan history
separately with `git rev-list --objects <ref>` plus `git cat-file -p` per blob against these rules.

deny.why: the real provider brand host. It reaches this repository through the m3u_sources setting, which _generate_csv_settings_header writes into the top of every CSV export
the provider's real CDN host labels, in URL or prose form
the real M3U account name suffixes. Each is three characters and means nothing to a generic scanner, which is the whole reason this list exists
this machine's Windows drive mapping of the container volumes
an internal backup location, not a path any user of this plugin has
the operator's personal account name, which appears in notification settings

allow.reason: the placeholder that replaces the real provider brand host. The .tv top level domain is preserved deliberately: a previous substitution to .example silently disabled a test gated on a TLD allowlist containing .tv
the placeholder form of an M3U account name in test fixtures. The real suffixes are in the deny list
the reserved documentation address ranges, used in tests proving an address is scrubbed out of an emailed report. These cannot be anyone's real network
the reserved IPv6 documentation range and a link-local example, used in the test proving IPv6 is scrubbed
contributor notes filenames. These files are gitignored and no longer tracked (2026-08-02); this entry only stops the filename itself being reported when it appears in .gitignore or in prose
the local planning directory for design documents, not a published path

named in .gitignore, which is tracked and must name the file in order to ignore it. docs/CLAUDE-HISTORY.md is the pre-prune copy of the agent notes and is NOT tracked; the ignore entry is what keeps it that way, so this reference is the mechanism preventing publication rather than an instance of it. The name cannot be changed: Backup-Notes.ps1 sweeps docs/CLAUDE-*.md, so renaming it would remove its only backup.
